vector_memory.semantic_summary: This interface defines the canonical data structure for any asset managed within the editor system. It serves as a core contract, ensuring all assets possess consistent metadata for traversal and identification. It models assets as having a unique ID, name, virtual path, and type, while optionally supporting a hierarchy via children. This component is fundamental to the editor's content management architecture.

graph_nodes.label: Interface
graph_nodes.name: IAsset
graph_nodes.signature: export interface IAsset { id: string; name: string; virtualPath: string; type: 'file' | 'folder' | string; projectId: string; children?: IAsset[]; }
